entries.heading: None of the funds appropriated by this Act for programs
ancestors: DIVISION C—DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2016
entries.text:
Sec. 8083.  None of the funds appropriated by this Act for programs 
of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence shall remain 
available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year, except for 
funds appropriated for research and technology, which shall remain 
available until September 30, 2017.
